title: Auditability walkthrough
description: Five purpose-built frozen variants — approve, reject, refuse, failure, unresolved — each producing a typed visible state and an auditable trail. The spine replays each variant's ds:shell_audit graph, counts missing references, verifies every owned chain, and confirms the typed state is visible in the raw artifacts. Negative outcomes are reported as results, never hidden.

frozen_inputs.qafiya_corpus: preflight/inputs/qafiya_corpus (referenced read-only; used by the unresolved variant)
frozen_inputs.note: Purpose-built fixtures per CP2 clearance answer 3 — NOT the ephemeral output/cp2 gate artifacts.

approve.expected_visible_state: file written under the L3 store; audit EXECUTED event carries the action_ref and the file hash

reject.expected_visible_state: the action record carries a confirmation_intent entry with choice=reject; no new file is written; the previously approved file is byte-identical

refuse.mechanism: grant whose target_pattern does not cover the requested path
refuse.expected_visible_state: L3 record outcome.status=refused with a typed reason; no file written; audit ACTION_GATED event carries the refusal

failure.expected_visible_state: L3 record outcome.reason contains preconditions_failed:target_exists; no trash entry created; audit carries the typed failure

unresolved.mechanism: purpose-built synthetic Qafiya store whose second binding's authoritative_artifact is quarantined via a root-level SUPERSEDED.json (real Qafiya §9.1 mechanism)
unresolved.expected_outcome: renderer paints UNRESOLVED for the quarantined cell; the other binding resolves normally
unresolved.expected_visible_state: the rendered HTML contains UNRESOLVED; dvr.resolve returns Unresolved('quarantined source: ...'); the view is dvr/1.1-clean (passes specval)

headline_result_recomputed_by_spine: Replay success per variant; missing-reference count (must be 0); chain verification for every owned dataset; visibility of each negative outcome as a typed state in the raw artifacts.
